name: shader-god-rays
title: God Rays
description: Volumetric light rays fan out from a source just above the frame: soft, slowly moving shafts of light in your palette, drawn in WebGL.
useWhen: A hero or reveal scene wants cinematic volumetric light rays from a corner source.
You want atmosphere and depth behind a title without geometric structure.
The palette is dark and you want soft neutral rays (override `colors` to brand-tint).
avoidWhen: The brief bans decorative glow: keep `bloom` and `intensity` restrained so it does not read as a generic glow.
You want structured or cellular motion: use shader-dot-orbit or shader-voronoi.
Bright rays would wash out foreground text: lower `intensity` and `bloom`.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Ray colors
variables.description: Up to 5 colors, comma separated, for the rays.

variables.label: Bloom color
variables.description: Color overlay blended with the rays; needs bloom above 0.

variables.label: Spotty
variables.description: Higher gives shorter rays and more spots.

variables.label: Bloom
variables.description: Strength of the overlay: 0 blends it normally, 1 adds it.

variables.label: Glow size
variables.description: Size of the circular glow at the source.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the shader in or out.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it when fine detail looks soft.
